sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: A software consumer that can use tools while pursuing a task.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: An assistant can look up information before deciding what to say or request next.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: An agent asks what Joule Studio is and receives authorized supporting evidence.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: The repository exposes knowledge to agents through adapters; it does not make every consumer a built-in autonomous agent.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Separating consumers from contracts allows different agent frameworks to use the same context.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: Agent requests cannot bypass policy, source authorization or human approval. A2A production integration remains deferred.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.body: Open the checked implementation, tests, contracts and migrations below. These links identify evidence, not new verification.
